summary: Spyre Therapeutics filed an 8-K furnishing a press release with positive Phase 2 SKYLINE Part A induction topline data for SPY002 in ulcerative colitis. The filing is a routine clinical-data disclosure under Item 7.01/8.01, not a special-situation corporate event. No deal, activist, strategic review, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation category applies. The data release is immaterial to special-situation classification.
